message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on facts. Facts: Xiong (邢某) was accountant, cash custodian. He was entrusted to keep and disburse land compensation funds (100.016 million). He misappropriated 300,000 yuan (30万元) from the compensation fund, lent to Jiang某甲. Later Jiang某乙 (maybe) returned 30万元 from another source. So the crime is embezzlement (挪用公款) i.e., "挪用公款罪" (misappropriation of public funds) under Chinese criminal law. Also possibly "受贿"? No, he didn't receive bribes. He misused entrusted public funds. So the appropriate charge: "挪用公款罪". Also maybe "职务侵占"? In Chinese law, misappropriation of public funds by a public official is "挪用公款罪". If the funds are public money, yes. The facts show he was entrusted as accountant for a government project, so it's public funds. So single crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]挪用公款罪<eoa>
